## One move

A name shared by several lines stands for all of them, and mixes with numbers.
The comments are gone from the slide; `mark=` searches the code without them.

::: {.explain-code}
```{.go}
func (b *Board) Drop(col int, p Player) error {
	row := b.freeRow(col) // <line=find>
	if row < 0 {          //<line=full>
		return ErrColumnFull
	}                     // <line=full>
	url := "http://example.org" // <line=place>
	b.cells[row][col] = p // <line=place>
	return nil
}
```
